title: Cartridge
description: A cartridge configuration for the Cartridge Console AI interface

long_description.description: Detailed markdown description for store listing

repository.description: URL to the source repository (GitHub, GitLab, etc.)

homepage.description: URL to the cartridge's homepage or documentation

readme.description: Inline markdown readme with usage instructions, shown in the store

icon.description: Emoji or URL to pixel art icon

system_prompt.description: The core instruction for the model

tools.description: Tool IDs this cartridge enables (built-in or user plugin IDs)

screen_tint.description: Subtle overlay color for the screen area (rgba)

glow_color.description: Color of the screen edge glow

boot_message.description: First message shown when cartridge loads

conflicts_with.description: Cartridge IDs that cannot be loaded together

requires.description: Cartridge IDs that must be loaded for this to work

merge_strategy.description: How this cartridge's prompt merges with others

memory_enabled.description: Whether to persist state across sessions

suggested_prompts.description: Example prompts shown on the welcome screen when this cartridge loads

suggested_thinking.description: Whether CoT should be on by default

suggested_max_rounds.description: Maximum number of tool-calling rounds per turn

suggested_temperature.description: Preferred sampling temperature (0.0-2.0). Higher = more creative, lower = more deterministic. If not set, defaults are used (1.0 for thinking, 0.7 otherwise).

suggested_top_p.description: Preferred nucleus sampling threshold (0.0-1.0). If not set, defaults are used (0.95 for thinking, 0.8 otherwise).

suggested_model.description: Preferred model ID for this kasset (e.g. 'mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-MLX-4bit'). If set, the UI will suggest switching to this model when the kasset is loaded.

input_methods.description: Input type IDs this kasset exposes for request_user_input calls (e.g. 'file_selector', 'range_slider', 'code_reviewer'). Each ID must match a builtin or user-installed input type manifest.
